reason: Batch 003 source audit removed unsupported penalty ranges, restitution amounts, dollar values, and scenario statistics; questions now use RA 9266 IRR and UAP Code of Ethics conduct categories.

proposed.text: A supplier offers the architect a commission or favor for specifying its product, creating reciprocal obligation. Which source-backed issue is tested?

options.text: No issue if the product is technically acceptable
Conflict of interest and prohibited commission/favor under the UAP Code of Ethics
Civil Code Article 1723 collapse liability only

proposed.rationale: The UAP Code of Ethics prohibits commissions, discounts, fees, gifts, or favors from material/equipment firms when they create reciprocal obligation, and market discounts belong to the client.
proposed.explanation: The old contractor-side temporary-facility scenario was not supported by the checked local ethics sources.
